games.name: Don’t Steal the Bobo 🐻
games.desc:
Welcome to Don’t Steal the Bobo! 🐻

How to Play:
• Sneak up and steal Bobos while they sleep😴
• RUN when they wake up and chase you!🏃
• Take them home and collect tons of cash💸
• Upgrade your characters to earn even more🔥
• Expand your plot to unlock extra slots🏗️
• Trade & gift Bobos with friends to grow together!🎁
• Complete your Index to unlock cash boosts & base colors!📖
• But be careful... a sleeping Bobo can WAKE at any second!🤫

Remember, your Bobos earn cash even while you're offline!⏰

games.name: Hike For Eggs
games.desc:
🥾 Welcome to Hike for Eggs!

How to Play:
🏔️ Hike up the mountain trail to find animal nests
🥚 Steal eggs from sleeping animal parents
🏃 Run back to base before the parent catches you!
🐣 Hatch eggs in your pen to collect over 100 animal types!
💰 Earn money from your pets
💪 Train Strength to climb faster and outrun bigger parents
🥢 Buy better hiking poles to train Strength faster
🏕️ Build ranger camps and send rangers to fetch eggs for you
✨ Climb 18 stages, from a Goat in the Foothills to a Dragon on Genesis Summit, and discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

games.name: Emergency Hamburg
games.desc:
Emergency Hamburg is an emergency services roleplay (RP) game set in the German city of Hamburg. Play as a police officer, firefighter, medic, criminal, car mechanic, bus driver, truck driver, or civilian - team up with friends in a huge open city with realistic vehicles, robberies, and emergency callouts.

🔰 NEW TO THE GAME? Read our Beginner's Guide: devforum.roblox.com/t/4812499

👮 Enforce the law, respond to calls, and arrest criminals - unlock Traffic Police, Undercover, and SEK.
💰 Rob the bank, jeweler, and harbor containers, escape the police, and get rich as a criminal.
🚒 Extinguish fires as a firefighter, revive downed players as a medic.
🔧 Tow broken vehicles and repair traffic lights as a car mechanic.
🚚 Deliver cargo as a truck driver. 
🚌 Drive city and rural bus routes.
🚗 Earn money, buy your dream car, and tune it your way.
🗺️ Explore Hamburg and write your own story as a civilian.

📋 Latest updates: devforum.roblox.com/t/2388146

games.name: Savannah Life
games.desc:
Experience life as Africa’s most iconic animals in Savannah Life, the ultimate survival adventure. Become a lion 🦁 and lead your pride to glory. games.name: Death Order: Simon Says
games.desc:
The Deadliest Game of Simon Says You Will Ever Play. 

🚨 Use Code "RELEASE" for 1,000 Cash

You wake up in a prison with no memory of how you got there. To survive, you follow Simon's orders — but only when he says "Simon Says." Get it wrong and you die. No one knows what Simon really wants, or why you're here. Outlast everyone, and maybe you'll find out.

🎮 Full controls in Settings → Mobile HUD Editor, PC Keybinds, Controller Binds. Don't like them? Rebind or Rebuild every one.

93% Never Make It Out, Good Luck
